name: seo
title: SEO, link previews and prerendering
summary: Per-route title/description/canonical/Open Graph/JSON-LD from one config, build-time prerender of every public route, sitemap.xml, robots.txt and a 404.html.
when: The site will be shared (WhatsApp, Slack, LinkedIn previews) or should be found on Google. Almost always, for a real launch.

chainScripts.postbuild: vite build --config vite.prerender.config.mjs --logLevel warn && node scripts/prerender.mjs && node scripts/build-sitemap.mjs

next: Fill in src/seo/seo.config.json: origin, siteName, socialImage, and one entry per public route.
Put a 1200x630 social image at public/<socialImage.path>.
After `npm run build`, run `npm run seo:check`.
